# How Can I Build a Full 360 Dashboard for Property Management?


You build a full 360-degree dashboard by combining occupancy, revenue, maintenance, and guest satisfaction into one live view, instead of five separately compiled reports. On **Jestor** , dashboards pull directly from the same relational tables the operation runs on.


A true "360" view of short stay operations is only useful if it genuinely combines operational and financial data, separate reports by area never actually reach that view without constant manual rebuilding.


## What prevents a real 360 view in short stay


- Occupancy, financial, and maintenance data living in separate tools or spreadsheets
- Manual compilation required for any view spanning these areas
- No single indicator spanning more than one dimension of the operation
- Dashboards rebuilt with delay, instead of updating live


## How the 360 dashboard works


- **Apps** built on connected **tables** pull live data from reservations, finance, and maintenance
- Composite indicators can combine occupancy, revenue, and maintenance SLA
- Conditional formatting highlights properties or metrics needing attention
- The AI-assisted app builder can generate a dashboard structure from a text description


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- One structure covers reservations, finance, maintenance, and the dashboards visualizing them
- No separate BI tool needed for a genuine 360 view
- Non-technical managers can build or adjust dashboards without a developer
- Updates are live, since the dashboard reads the same data the operation runs on


Manual per-area report Real-time 360 dashboard


Rebuilt with delay, manually Updates live from connected data


## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does this require a separate BI tool?** No, the dashboard is built on the same connected tables as the rest of the operation. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can non-technical managers build this themselves?** Yes, visually or by describing what they need to the AI builder.


**Does the dashboard update automatically as data changes?** Yes, it reflects live data in real time.
